brand.name: Brand
brand.logo_info: If empty, the theme uses the Kuki logo bundled with it.

delivery.name: Delivery & bag
delivery.threshold_info: Must match your shipping rate in Settings › Shipping and delivery. Used by the bag meter and every free-delivery line.
delivery.bag_meter: Show the free-delivery string on the bag
delivery.bag_suggestions: Suggest one flavour that gets the bag to free delivery
delivery.delivery_note_info: Only write what's true for every order, e.g. where you deliver.

contact.name: Contact
contact.whatsapp_info: With country code, e.g. +91 98230 12354. Used by every WhatsApp link and the gifting enquiry.

legal.name: Legal
legal.fssai_info: Shown in the footer. Hidden while empty.

motion.name: Motion & sound
motion.enable_3d_info: Only loads after the page shows, and only on devices that can run it. Everyone else gets the 2D shelf.
motion.sound_default_info: Leave off. Visitors can switch sound on from the shelf.
motion.haptics: Little vibration on each lid click (Android)

sharing.name: Sharing & search
sharing.share_image_info: Used when a page is shared on WhatsApp or social. Flavours use their own photo.
sharing.meta_description_info: Shown by Google when a page has no description of its own.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.publish_events: Send shop events (twist, size switch, add to bag…) to Shopify customer events
analytics.publish_events_info: Read them with a custom pixel in Settings › Customer events.
